method.coarse: Original qualified image, profiler image disabled, coarse full-prefix mode; four crops x six rotated/reversed rounds, 24 prefix requests per mode. CPU2 host affinity, same power configuration.
method.detail: Seven single-band requests per crop, eight phases covering every executed block once plus a fully bracketed cross-check. Packing, pre-HMX fence, HMX clear/load/store, coefficient splat, tap reduction and post/store brackets.
method.hmx: HMX clear/load/store ends with the existing assembly barrier. Separate packing_fence precedes HMX and can drain prior VTCM traffic. No pure MAC-only timing claimed.
method.interpretation: Fine interval totals reconstruct separate single-band probes. Timer placement, asynchronous completion and profiler bookkeeping shift the split. Sampled/full variants are shown; they are not forced into an additive partition of original runtime. Coarse operator/global brackets are primary attribution.
method.halo: Core blocks lie wholly in local rows1..16; halo blocks wholly outside; mixed blocks straddle the boundary. Overlapping subtotals include halo/padding and unused rows. They are not a measured saving from a halo-reuse implementation. Census separately counts repeated valid positions.
method.calibration: 256 adjacent counter-read pairs per request. No overhead subtraction. Counter ticks19.2MHz (19200/ms). Log-copy cost reported separately.
method.safety: Same owned memory/code and 20 ms budget. VTCM log vectors14016..14144; 16384-byte validated disjoint DDR log. Detailed modes require one band. Outputs byte-identical to unmodified image, full RGB/head qualification and controls run first.
method.format: 72-element block arrays compacted to one line; all samples preserved, no activation/image/weight data.
